results.title: Kyirong-Rasuwa is China's preferred route to connect Tibet to Nepal.
results.description:
Kyirong-Rasuwa is China's preferred route to connect Tibet to Nepal. By concentrating settlement along river valleys in an unstable geology and cryosphere, the logistical violence of the corridor leads to tragic death. My latest in Positions Politics.
